summary: Retired the launcher's copied architecture relations, and after CD-0219 recorded that the launcher display obligations have no subject while exact Domain-detail reads retained the Domain graph. Registry participation, optional applicability, warning and strict adoption, and navigation completeness obligations remained in force. CD-0222 later retired those remaining navigation obligations; the Domain-detail relation retention and the store query bounds and authority carry forward there.
title: Repository navigation consumes the Domain graph without launcher copies
